ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BayShop uses your location when you select the nearest pickup point.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: BayShop uses the camera when you choose to photograph a parcel or document, or send a photo to support.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BayShop uses the microphone when you choose to record a message for support.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BayShop accesses the photos you select to attach them to parcels, documents or support messages.
